```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# --- User-editable paths ----------------------------------------------------
expr_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drjuliejung/GRN-shiny/main/values_All_nottransformed.csv"
gtf_file <- "/home/ocdm0351/.conda/envs/snpEff/share/snpeff-5.2-2/data/P_pacificus/Elpaco/genes.gtf"
outdir   <- path.expand("/home/ocdm0351/DPhil/R_Data/")
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Read expression matrix
expr <- read.csv(expr_url, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
message("Loaded expression matrix: ", nrow(expr), " genes x ", ncol(expr), " samples")

# 2) detect timepoints from columns of form AG_*_n (capture the middle token)
#    regex: ^AG_([^_]+)_[0-9]+$
col_names <- colnames(expr)
m <- regexec("^AG_([^_]+)_[0-9]+$", col_names)
matches <- regmatches(col_names, m)
# extract token (group 1) where match exists
timepoints <- unique(unlist(lapply(matches, function(x) if(length(x)>=2) x[2] else NULL)))
timepoints <- timepoints[!is.na(timepoints) & nzchar(timepoints)]
if (length(timepoints) == 0) stop("No AG_*_n columns found. Column names: ", paste(head(col_names,40), collapse = ", "))
message("Detected timepoints: ", paste(timepoints, collapse = ", "))

# 3) build mapping table from GTF once (PPA -> WBGene) if GTF exists
map <- NULL
if (file.exists(gtf_file)) {
  message("Parsing GTF for mapping: ", gtf_file)
  gtf_lines <- readLines(gtf_file, warn = FALSE)
  gtf_lines <- gtf_lines[!grepl("^\\s*#", gtf_lines)]
  # keep only gene lines (avoid duplicating mapping from exon/transcript lines)
  gtf_gene <- gtf_lines[sapply(strsplit(gtf_lines, "\t", fixed = TRUE), function(x) length(x) >= 9 && x[3] == "gene")]
  if (length(gtf_gene) > 0) {
    attrs <- sapply(gtf_gene, function(l) strsplit(l, "\t", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][9], USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    extract_attr <- function(key, attrs_vec=attrs) {
      pat <- paste0(key, ' "([^"]+)"')
      m <- regexec(pat, attrs_vec)
      sapply(regmatches(attrs_vec, m), function(x) if (length(x) >= 2) x[2] else NA_character_)
    }
    map <- data.frame(PPA = extract_attr("gene_name"), WBGene = extract_attr("gene_id"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    map <- unique(map[!is.na(map$PPA) & !is.na(map$WBGene), ])
    message("Extracted ", nrow(map), " unique PPA <-> WBGene mappings from GTF")
  } else {
    message("No 'gene' feature lines found in GTF; mapping not created.")
  }
} else {
  message("GTF not found at: ", gtf_file, " — output will keep PPA IDs.")
}

# ensure output dir
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

# 4) for each timepoint collapse replicates and save a TSV
for (tp in sort(timepoints)) {
  pattern <- paste0("^AG_", tp, "_[0-9]+$")
  cols <- grep(pattern, col_names, value = TRUE)
  if (length(cols) == 0) {
    message("No columns found for timepoint ", tp, " (pattern ", pattern, ") — skipping")
    next
  }
  message("Processing timepoint ", tp, ": found ", length(cols), " columns")
  df <- data.frame(
    PPA = rownames(expr),
    logVST = rowMeans(expr[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = NULL
  )
  # map to WBGene if mapping available
  if (!is.null(map)) {
    ix <- match(df$PPA, map$PPA)
    df$Gene_ID <- ifelse(!is.na(ix) & nzchar(map$WBGene[ix]), map$WBGene[ix], df$PPA)
  } else {
    df$Gene_ID <- df$PPA
  }
  out <- df[, c("Gene_ID", "logVST")]
  outpath <- file.path(outdir, paste0("P_pacificus_Embryonic_TimeSeries_", tp, "_Expression.tsv")) 
  write.table(out, outpath, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  message("Saved: ", outpath, " (", nrow(out), " rows)")
}

message("Done — produced files for timepoints: ", paste(sort(timepoints), collapse = ", "))
```
